title: 支え手の継承
status: research prototype; production adoption on hold

target_domains.ordinary_material: 現行の炎・水・風・土の基本作用。今回の相互作用へ物理状態を逆流させない。
target_domains.exposed_spell_result: 今回追加する、接触可能な術の余韻。普通の光や水そのものとは別。
target_domains.sealed_alumni_spell: 透明封緘の内側。観測できるが裸の支え端へ触れられない。光は先輩から奪わない。

state_fields.manual: 術者が直接支えている
state_fields.from: 触れている余韻の出所。none/fire/water/wind/earth。

transition_rules: cast creates or reactivates the selected result, sets manual=true, and binds to the chosen existing result or none
fire cast deposits up to 8 night units in that lamp seat
release only changes manual support; physical water, stone and fuel-lamp states are not rewound
a result remains iff it exists and is manually supported, or receives its accepted live result
use the greatest fixed point for already-created results; positive charge is separately required for illumination
wrong type, self reference, absent donor, or ordinary object supplies no support after release
one illuminated simulated night consumes one unit; at zero the form remains but the lamp does not illuminate

persistence.school_maintenance: replenish on every seventh night, keeping the graduate's pattern
persistence.prototype_time: discrete optional research action, not a gameplay wait

fire.target: exposed fire result, not lamp fixture
fire.positive: water remains when its own hand releases and fire is held
fire.negative: water fades when fire support is also removed

water.target: water's magical image, not sealed gas or liquid volume
water.positive: wind carries image while the physical water stays
water.negative: wind on exterior cloth does not obtain this support

wind.target: one continuous circulation along the existing band boundary
wind.positive: earth retains the whole boundary shape, including the task region
wind.negative: moving the windowsill itself is not that support relation
wind.topology: 2000 boundary nodes; 1000 center-lap steps flip edge; 2000 return

earth.target: earth magic's contour, not ordinary rock
earth.positive: fire lights the contour without burning the stone
earth.negative: warming ordinary rock is not receiving the earth result

reproducibility: same current state gives same effect; no visit counts, spell history requirements, randomness or cooldown
graduation_condition: at the new hall seat, all four results exist and remain with no manual support and charge > 0
known_limits: after discovering a four-attribute loop, six cyclic orders can be tried
three exclusive conversion rules plus the loop goal predict the fourth
players may learn the same laws through hall experiments instead of revisiting rooms
four local positive observations do not rule out all extra-compatible laws
shape contents are simplified by scene; no general cross-scene shape-data simulation
human insight and enjoyment have not been tested
